overview_description.description: Upwind Security offers a cloud security platform that protects cloud infrastructure, workloads, applications, and APIs by using runtime data to provide real-time visibility and threat detection. It delivers a centralized runtime fabric that maps network and application topology, correlates signals from sensors, logs and APIs, and helps teams reduce alert noise and focus on risks that matter most. The platform combines capabilities for posture management, vulnerability and identity security, container and serverless protection, and cloud detection and response within a single environment. Upwind also includes tools for infrastructure-as-code security and runtime-native analysis, allowing security and development teams to prioritize fixes with contextual insight. Its approach aims to connect build-time and runtime intelligence for comprehensive cloud risk assessment and mitigation.

about_short_description.short_description: Upwind Security provides unified cloud and application security, using real-time visibility to identify threats and protect data integrity.

product.name: Upwind CNAPP
product.description: A cloud-native application protection platform that unifies cloud visibility, posture management, vulnerability prioritization, runtime protection, and threat detection across infrastructure and applications.

product.name: Cloud Detection & Response (CDR)
product.description: A cloud detection and response solution that baselines cloud and application activity, detects anomalous behavior, correlates security context, and supports rapid investigation and response.

product.name: Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)
product.description: A cloud security posture management solution that inventories cloud assets, identifies misconfigurations and exposures, prioritizes risks using runtime context, and monitors compliance across cloud environments.

product.name: Container & Kubernetes Security
product.description: A security solution for containers and Kubernetes that provides build-to-runtime visibility, posture monitoring, policy enforcement, risk prioritization, and real-time threat detection across cloud and hybrid environments.

product.name: API Security
product.description: A cloud and application API security solution that provides visibility into API endpoints, usage, data flows, and runtime behavior while detecting threats and vulnerabilities.

product.name: Vulnerability Management
product.description: A vulnerability management solution that discovers vulnerabilities across cloud workloads and applications, evaluates them using real-world runtime context, and prioritizes remediation based on exposure and usage.
